summary: No data center facility may be established, re-established or expanded, and related zoning approvals and permits are blocked, through Nov 21, 2026 while a study is completed; downtown data centers of 350,000 sq ft or less are exempt.
notes: CONFLICT on the vote: 7-5 (MPR live) vs 8-5 (Broadband Breakfast). Mayor Frey opposed.
